originality.rationale: No located source or indexed prior claim establishes a minimum graph order and unique infection-rate switch for the specific exact continuous-time SIS cumulative infected person-time optimization. value.rationale: The result gives a complete and sharp smallest-network answer for a natural SIS intervention policy under a persistent reinfection-sensitive cumulative health-loss measure. It demonstrates a genuine rate-driven change between the residual path and a clustered-plus-isolated contact configuration, a distinction not captured by final-size SIR heuristics; serves as a tractable exact benchmark for SIS interventions rather than a claim of empirical vaccine effectiveness.
